explanation: The Almighty Creator who loves the world so much that he gave his only Son for humanity's salvation.
Everything created, including humankind, which stands in need of God's grace and love.
The title of Jesus' unique position as the one and true Son of God the Father.
The concept of being saved from the judgment of sin through faith in Jesus Christ, so that one receives eternal life.
The endless life in fellowship with God given to those who believe in the name of the Son.
The state of those who do not believe and therefore stand under God's righteous judgment over sin.
The truth about Jesus Christ that reveals humanity's true nature and the way to salvation, as opposed to the darkness of sin.
The power of sin and lack of knowledge of God that keep people away from the truth.
The concept of living a life characterized by God's will or, conversely, governed by one's own desires and darkness.
